contract.binary: exact paths and SHA-256; Git text attribute must be unset
contract.classification: exact path inventory; a new, missing, duplicate, or unknown path is fatal until reviewed policy bytes change
contract.first_party: valid UTF-8 whose decoded code points are all U+0000..U+007F; NUL is forbidden
contract.third_party: valid UTF-8 at exact paths; source/license SHA-256 is pinned so names and legal bytes cannot drift silently
